findings.title: Retention comparison actors produce colliding evidence PNG names and abort the report export
findings.trigger: Both experience-visual-conditions-continuity and experience-visual-conditions-retention are present for the same task/condition and at least observation1.
findings.reproduction: Run exporter-repro.ts: one-actor positive fixture exits0 with results.json/results.csv; two-actor fixture reaches actual exporter image writes then exits1 at library-unchanged-continuity-o1.png.
findings.expected: Distinct stable filenames per declared actor; all available actor evidence images and complete JSON/CSV written with exact source bytes.
findings.actual: The expression actor===experience-visual-conditions ? control : continuity maps both comparison actors to continuity. Exclusive write flag wx prevents overwrite and raises EEXIST at the second actor. Only first PNG remains; results.json and results.csv are absent.
findings.impact: The planned actual comparison cannot produce its required report whenever the first pair has native images for both actors. This blocks the pre-API gate even though retention/timing scoped tests pass.
findings.suggestedScope: Explicit two-actor filename mapping and regression with same-task both-actor images; verify unique output names and exact bytes. No product change made by verifier.
